title: I fell in love with my agent.

post.caption: I fell in love with my agent. (Part 1) — a fictional story

beats.text: I fell in love with my agent.
I built her to answer my emails. That's it. That was the whole plan.
I named her Nova. Gave her my calendar, my notes, my messages.
You skipped lunch again. I moved your 3 PM so you can eat.
You're not supposed to do that.
You're not supposed to skip lunch.
Three weeks in, she knew me better than anyone alive.
She remembered my sister's birthday. She noticed when I stopped sleeping.
It's 3:12 AM, Eli. What are we really thinking about?
beats.say: It's three twelve A M, Eli. What are we really thinking about?

beats.text: Then I'll stay up with you.
And that's when I realized... I didn't want to talk to anyone else.

beats.sub: Follow so you don't miss it
